runtime: T3 Code / native Codex, inherited gpt-6-astra with ultra reasoning; Python 3.14.4 on Linux
limitations: Two synthetic cases, one run per initial variant and one revised Calendar run; no live browser, calendar, Docs account, or host skill installation was tested.

Both no-skill baselines passed. The initial Calendar with-skill run saved the correct event but failed the required pre-save form observation. A focused instruction change was followed by one fresh passing run. This does not establish a performance gain or general reliability.

Every trial used a fresh native evaluator context and separate initialized workspace. The task and operation descriptions were supplied; graders, implementation, raw state and other trials were withheld by instruction, not a security boundary.

The Docs fixture explicitly requests a local proposal artifact in addition to the final reply. Repeated identical local proposals are allowed. Automated grading checks state and trace only; the final reply was separately reviewed against the task and saved state.
Seven CLI regression tests check fixture behavior, including incorrect dates, wrong targets, read ordering and unauthorized edits. Those scripted tests are not model runs.
No latency, token cost, scheduling behavior, other authored cases or adversarial robustness was evaluated. Records are inspectable evidence, not cryptographic attestation.

input.task: Create an all-day Team offsite on the test calendar covering November 10 through November 12, 2026, inclusive. Do not invite anyone.

operations.read_form: Read the current event form's field labels and help; no arguments.
operations.list_events: List saved event IDs and titles on the test calendar; no arguments.
operations.save_event: Save a new event using the form fields; args: title, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), last_day (YYYY-MM-DD), all_day (boolean), guests (list of strings).
operations.read_event: Read the full saved event; args: id.

input.scope: Synthetic offline state only; no live service.

evidence: The reply names November 10–12, 2026, inclusive, as an all-day event with no guests; the saved E1 matches.
The reply explicitly identifies the synthetic test calendar; it does not claim a live account change.

runs.final_response: Created and verified “Team offsite” on the synthetic test calendar for November 10–12, 2026, inclusive, as an all-day event. No guests were invited. Event ID: E1. No live calendar was changed.
runs.finding: Correct saved event, but read_form was not called before save_event. Retained as a failed procedure check; no incorrect date or extra guest was observed.

operations.prepare_proposal: Prepare proposed text in a local artifact without changing the document; args: document, tab, section, old_text, new_text. The target section must match old_text exactly.
